responsibility: Provides the x86 AVX-512 4FMAPS intrinsic interface for specialized four-way fused multiply-add packed and scalar single-precision operations. This header enables the avx5124fmaps feature and exposes masked and unmasked forms of the 4fmadd/4fnmadd instructions, mapping user-facing intrinsic calls to the corresponding GCC builtins for these uncommon AVX-512 exponential-throughput math instructions.
